output_list.criticism: The mint function does not check for integer overflow when adding the _value to the totalSupply. This could lead to an incorrect totalSupply value and potentially allow for more tokens to be minted than the TOKEN_LIMIT.

The buyTokens function does not check for integer overflow when dividing the _value by pricePerToken. This could lead to an incorrect boughtTokens value and potentially allow for more tokens to be minted than the TOKEN_LIMIT.
